uri.description: uri for which artifacts are loaded, only used for read operations

xFeatures.description: Map of the {@link #mlPipe} `x` inputs names to corresponding string representations of {@link Feature.Set}s.

yFeatures.description: Map of the {@link #mlPipe} `y` inputs names to corresponding string representations of {@link Feature.Set}s.

runtimes.description: key is runtime name, value is runtime json string needed for execution of corresponding {@link MlPipe}.

files.description:
key is {@link MlPipeline#pipePaths}, value is the map.
key for value map is "fieldpath" of file fields in {@link MlPipe}, value is list of relative {@link ByteStream}s of files.

fileUrls.description:
key is {@link MlPipeline#pipePaths}, value is the map.
key for value map is "fieldpath" of file fields in {@link MlPipe}, value is list of {@link Url}s of files.

artifactsPath.description: Holds paths for storing artifacts associated with {@link ModelRegistryIface#register}

data.description:
key is vertex path of {@link MlPipeline}.
value is list of {@link ModelRegistry.Register.Data} associated with a path.

title: Type holding artifacts associated with {@link ModelRegistryIface#register}.
name: ModelRegistry.Register.Artifacts
